content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lexington

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher and are new to project management, you're eligible to pursue this credential today.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required project management education into a focused learning experience, allowing you to master core concepts and PMBOK® Guide principles on your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and complete your official CAPM application. Pay the required exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy will guide you through each step to ensure your application is complete and timely.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review key topics, practice questions, and test-taking strategies. Schedule your CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner and take the computer-based exam at a testing center convenient to you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your credential, commit to earning professional development units throughout the three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you stay current and maintain your certification without interruption.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for Lexington project managers?

While industry experience remains the primary driver of hiring, CAPM certification helps entry-level candidates differentiate themselves in a competitive market and signals commitment to PMI standards. Certified candidates are generally positioned for stronger offers, especially at UK HealthCare, Baptist Health, automotive suppliers, and logistics firms active in the region.

fq_items.question: Which Lexington industries most value CAPM or PMP certification?
fq_items.answer: Healthcare systems, advanced manufacturing, and IT service providers in Lexington list PMP or related certifications as preferred or required most frequently. UK HealthCare, Baptist Health Lexington, automotive component manufacturers, and logistics operations increasingly seek certified project managers to oversee complex initiatives. CAPM establishes foundational credibility before pursuing PMP; it's particularly valued as a stepping stone in these growth sectors where demand for certified talent remains strong.

fq_items.question: When should I pursue CAPM certification during my Lexington PM job search?

If you're already employed, completing it within your first year shows employers commitment to professional development. Lexington's competitive job market rewards certified candidates, so completing the credential before actively applying strengthens your positioning.
